origin: The unchanged user objective and explicit requirements for democracy, human/AI community improvement, future communication, English publication and usable organization, interpreted with AGENTS.md. The goal is not narrowed to these artifacts.

requirements.requirement: Better human lives across security, freedom, time, relationships, equality and agency
requirements.current_disposition: Causal mechanisms and real rivals are specified; package effects and multidimensional superiority over existing states remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Meaningful democracy, opposition, popular control, effective remedies and peaceful replacement
requirements.current_disposition: Substantive democratic chains exist and stale active consumers are repaired; actual opposition, independent control and timely execution remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: All major national functions and ordinary law, open to unidentified needs
requirements.current_disposition: Fourteen chapters and thirty-seven audited functions identify substantive choices; they do not prove exhaustive law, local annexes or full current resources.

requirements.requirement: Useful AI-assisted national administration/construction under accountable authority
requirements.current_disposition: A useful task portfolio, responsible owners and fallback/exit conditions are specified; actual gains and qualified paid alternatives remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: First principles across values, social mechanisms, scientific constraints and causal evidence
requirements.current_disposition: Values, scientific constraints and causal hypotheses are distinguished. No uniquely correct constitution follows from first principles alone.

requirements.requirement: Consistent future human/AI community improvement with objections, fresh review and migration
requirements.current_disposition: Proposed research checks and future-country update paths exist. Active consumer defects demonstrate why file checks alone cannot establish semantic closure.

requirements.requirement: Future communication/collaboration and replaceable mediation without confusing consent
requirements.current_disposition: Plural media, original meaning, scoped mandates and consent boundaries exist. Actual usability and excluded perspectives remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Enforceable ordinary civil/criminal law and bounded official power
requirements.current_disposition: Definite candidate civil, criminal and procedural cores exist. Current jurisdictional qualification, independent professional review and executed protection remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: A coherent materially possible national economy and delivery account
requirements.current_disposition: The main unfinished design account is a current matched work, price, receipt, provider, tax and source year. Residual output or profits cannot manufacture funding.

requirements.requirement: Ecology, future people, safe physical supply and external effects
requirements.current_disposition: Finite supply, capital, ecological and source comparisons exist. Actual safe quality, dynamics, owned foreign settlement and external harms remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: Safe failure and paid lawful transition preserving lives/claims and democratic succession
requirements.current_disposition: Transition, succession and continuity candidates exist. Actual paid accepting capacity, lawful public authority and delivered protection remain unverified.

requirements.requirement: English public artifacts and usable modular organization with stable current entries
requirements.current_disposition: English and current modular organization can be checked within scope. Navigation and source identities do not adopt procedures or prove better lives.
